<!-- pr-reviewer: 255413391b1660350fe08bd9e5c3905296f9fe3c -->
Needs changes before merge. SAFETY-tier review. Labels: `needs-rework` and `conflicts`.

I read the whole diff and checked the current laws on `upstream/main` at `d80dc6944f912171a06029f635e0450c505d44a9`.

**Requested before merge**

1. `crates/motion/src/turning/start_exit.rs:84` and `:113`: clippy rejects both `.map_err(&refuse)` calls. Use `.map_err(refuse)` and run clippy again. The same command passes on bare upstream main. This is a new failure on this head.

   ```text
   error: the borrowed expression implements the required traits
   crates/motion/src/turning/start_exit.rs:84:52
   crates/motion/src/turning/start_exit.rs:113:52
   clippy::needless_borrows_for_generic_args
   ```

2. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/turning_start_exit_rows.rs:51`: the new controls need before/after screenshots in the PR body. The body states that screenshots were not taken. Structural tests pass, but they do not meet this review requirement. Put the images on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch and link them from the body. Do not commit images to this PR branch.

3. The trial merge conflicts in these files:
   - `crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs`
   - `crates/app/src/operation/pick_kinds.rs`
   - `crates/app/tests/start_exit_shared.rs`

   Refresh the branch with upstream main and retain the changes from both branches. Run the selected checks on the final head. I aborted the trial merge without edits. There is no trial-merge commit whose first parent can be checked. All PR results below apply to the PR head, not a merged tree.

**Local results**

All commands ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-3981`. No GitHub runner ran.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 232 steps; 231 passed. The UI library step failed for the host limitation below. All motion and app steps passed.
- Motion library: 659 passed, 22 ignored. App library: 310 passed.
- `start_exit_shared`: 12 passed, including all eight new turning tests.
- All four new `turning_start_exit_rows::tests` passed.
- Catalog suites: `example_catalog` 43 passed, 4 ignored; `example_catalog_adaptive` 1 passed; `example_catalog_edge_work` 1 passed.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: 6 steps, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -j 16 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: failed with the two errors above. The identical command passed on bare upstream main.

The host has no available GPU adapter. The PR UI library run had 1644 passed, 7 failed, and 8 ignored. I ran the same suite from `crates/ui` on bare upstream main. It had 1650 passed, the same 7 failed, and 8 ignored. Six failures are in `egui_app::report_tests`; one is `egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds`. Both runs report:

```text
Failed to create render state: CustomNativeAdapterSelectionError("No adapter found")
egui headless run failed: no graphics adapter
```

These seven failures are environmental and do not block this PR.

The first cached quick run stalled before tests. I cleared the inherited `RUSTC_WRAPPER` and completed the direct run above.

**Extra suites run**

- `golden_cl`: 34 passed.
- `lathe_cycle_exit`: 6 passed.
- `lathe_post`: 7 passed.
- `lathe_post_css`: 10 passed.
- `lathe_post_inch`: 6 passed.
- `lathe_post_tormach`: 8 passed.

No fixture or importer change requires the extra kernel suites. No recorded program or golden file moved. The unchanged catalog and lathe goldens passed.

**Mutations run by this reviewer**

| Guard removed temporarily | Pin | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Start rapid stock check | `a_rapid_through_the_bar_is_refused_by_name` | Red: 1 failed |
| Cycle and compensation check | `a_path_with_a_canned_cycle_takes_no_pick` | Red: 1 failed |
| Both guards restored | `turning::start_exit::tests::*` | Green: 8 passed |

The source is restored. The worktree has no tracked changes. I left the worktree and branch in place. Full heavy lanes did not run, as required by the current review law.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

1. Removed both closure borrows in `start_exit.rs`. All-target clippy passes for motion, app, and UI. Restoring the borrows gave the two reported lint failures. Restoring the fix passed.
2. Added before/after screenshots to the PR body. Immutable image commit: `e4452a337c430060533628776372d2f45dd75e42` on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. The images show the real Geometry page through software rendering of egui meshes. All four turning UI tests pass. No image or capture code is on this PR branch.
3. Merged upstream main through `baad348f191a5f2261dc778ac3f9853aaf19ffa0`. The resolutions retain wire, Slot, and turning support. `every_kind_has_one_pick_capability_and_only_the_taken_ones_take_a_pick` pins the capability changes. Removing Threading exit support or Meridian exit support independently made it fail. All 12 shared tests pass after restoration and on the final head.

New head: `449c54fd935d9dd7a6b0d800b6664542bd26ed70`.

Final checks: quick 234 steps, 233 passed. Its sole failed step has the same seven no-GPU failures documented in the review. Clippy passes. Selected heavy: 4 steps passed. Light: 6 steps passed. All nine catalog and golden suites pass. No recorded program moved in the PR diff. The body gives commands, counts, and limits.

The PR remains a draft. The warm worktree remains in place. Please re-review this head.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 449c54fd935d9dd7a6b0d800b6664542bd26ed70 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge. This is a re-review at the SAFETY tier. Label: `merge-ready`.

The head `449c54fd9` already contains `upstream/main` at `baad348f191a5f2261dc778ac3f9853aaf19ffa0`. The trial merge gave "Already up to date". All results below apply to this head. I judged the laws by the current `upstream/main:AGENTS.md`.

**Earlier findings (review of `255413391`)**

1. Clippy `needless_borrows_for_generic_args` at `crates/motion/src/turning/start_exit.rs:84` and `:113`: **fixed** in `a966f17eb`. Both calls now use `.map_err(refuse)`. Clippy with `-D warnings` passes on this head (see below).
2. Before/after screenshots for the new UI rows: **fixed**. The body links three images on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch at commit `e4452a337c43`: `before.png`, `after-default.png` and `after-stated.png`. I confirmed that the three files exist at that commit. The PR branch has no image files.
3. Trial-merge conflicts in `tools.rs`, `pick_kinds.rs` and `start_exit_shared.rs`: **fixed**. I read the `--remerge-diff` of the two merge commits. Each resolution keeps both sides:
   - `PickCapability::takes` keeps the wire exit (#3332) and adds `Meridian`.
   - The `edit_operation` description keeps the wire text and adds the lathe kinds.
   - `KindInfo::pick` keeps `Slot => Ends` (#3325) and adds the three turning kinds and the Threading reason.
   - The shared capability test asserts the wire exit, `Meridian` and `Slot`.

**Results, run locally on this host** (no GitHub runner)

The gate with the compile cache stalled in `sccache` during the motion build (15 min with no output; the watchdog stopped it). This is a host problem. I ran the same gate steps again with `CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE=1`:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`, in three parts (`--only motion`, `--only app`, `--only ui`): 22 + 202 + 10 = 234 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled.
  - Motion lib: 673 passed, 22 ignored.
  - App lib: 311 passed.
  - `start_exit_shared`: 12 passed (the eight turning tests and the shared capability test).
  - `example_catalog`: 43 passed, 4 ignored. `example_catalog_adaptive`: 1 passed. `example_catalog_edge_work`: 1 passed.
  - UI lib: 1671 passed, 0 failed, 8 ignored. The host had a graphics adapter for this run. The four `turning_start_exit_rows::tests` passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: 6 steps, 0 failed.
- Heavy lanes: not run. This is a `P2` PR, so the review law does not ask for a heavy step.

**Extra suites run**

- `golden_cl`: 34 passed.
- `lathe_cycle_exit`: 6 passed.
- `lathe_post`: 7 passed.
- `lathe_post_css`: 10 passed.
- `lathe_post_inch`: 6 passed.
- `lathe_post_tormach`: 8 passed.

The diff has no change in `testdata/` or in the importers, so the kernel STEP suites were not necessary.

**Goldens moved**

None. `git diff upstream/main HEAD --stat` shows 14 files. None of them is a `*.nc`, `*.cl` or `examples/catalog/**` file. The body says "None", which is correct. The catalog and lathe goldens pass unchanged. When a kind has no pick, the path does not change (`no_pick_gives_the_path_back_unchanged`).

**Mutations run by this reviewer** (each was reverted; the worktree has no changes)

| Guard disabled | Pin | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Exit lift law (`part.lifts`, `start_exit.rs:127`) | `each_law_refuses_by_name` | Red: 1 failed |
| Start feed clearance (`start_exit.rs:95`) | `each_law_refuses_by_name`, `a_pick_whose_move_crosses_the_part_or_the_stock_is_refused_by_name` | Red: 1 failed in motion, 1 failed in app |
| Exit rapid stock check (`bar.crossed(p, h)`, `start_exit.rs:133`) | none | Green: no test failed (see the follow-up) |
| All guards put back | `turning::start_exit::tests::*` | Green: 8 passed |

**Follow-ups (file after merge)**

1. `crates/motion/src/turning/start_exit.rs:133`: no test pins the exit rapid stock check. When I disabled it, the motion unit tests and `start_exit_shared` stayed green. The code is correct as it is now, so this is not a blocker. Add a unit test with an exit pick past the free end at a small radius and a home point outside the radius behind the free end. The rapid between them must be refused by name. Suggested priority: `P7`, `effort:low`.

**Optional, non-blocking**

- The "Start X" and "Exit X" rows take model X. The planner reads the radius about the fitted axis. These agree only when the turning axis is on the model origin. The body lists that case under "Not exercised". A row hint that says "radius" (not diameter) can help a lathe user.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Left for the maintainer: the only collaborator `pr-reviewer` marker on the head is set by the PR author's own account (mkinney) with no evidence of a different reviewer agent, and the diff is safety-tier turning geometry (P2). Not counted as a review; not merged in the sweep.

Merge (coordinator of NeoTech): no refresh was necessary, the head merges cleanly with `main` at `baad348f1`. The merge relies on the clean collaborator review of 2026-11-25T13:40:06Z on head `449c54fd9`. Nothing was pushed after that review.
